title: Photography
slide_intent: Choose human moments people can relate to so connectivity is understood through lived experience.
strategic_value: A diverse collage of shared activities can make T-Mobile’s customer-centered positioning visible beyond devices.
demonstration: A large friend-group image anchors smaller photographs of families, couples and everyday activities.
practical_value: Select images for spontaneous human connection, with devices supporting rather than replacing the people.

content_islands.name: Photography direction
content_islands.spec: Place the documentary-style brief and access note in the left column.

content_islands.name: Human-moment collage
content_islands.spec: Use a large outdoor group photograph above and beside smaller everyday relationship images.

ingredient.name: Customer photography
ingredient.role: Make connectivity tangible through people and relationships.
ingredient.application: Favor real people, lively moments, local settings and a mobile-documentary viewpoint; allow natural camera awareness.
ingredient.scope: Still and motion imagery; the page offers art direction, not proof that each photograph is unstaged.
